dead_ends.tried: spawnDetached piping the detached child's stdout/stderr through this process (child.stdout.pipe(log))
dead_ends.why_it_failed: keeps the parent's event loop alive waiting to drain the pipe -- serve-target-site.ts never exited even after the server was confirmed up. Fixed: write directly to a file descriptor via stdio:[ignore,fd,fd], no pipe.

dead_ends.tried: spawning the target-site server via `npx next start -p <port>` with shell:true
dead_ends.why_it_failed: child.pid is the transient cmd.exe wrapper's PID, which can exit while a grandchild node process keeps serving -- stop-target-site.ts then finds nothing to kill. Fixed: spawn `node <target-site>/node_modules/next/dist/bin/next start -p <port>` directly, shell:false, so the recorded PID is the actual server process.

dead_ends.tried: detached: process.platform !== "win32" (assumed only POSIX needs the detached flag)
dead_ends.why_it_failed: on win32 this evaluates to false, so the child stays attached to the spawning console session and dies the instant that console is torn down (confirmed via a matched diagnostic: detached:true survived across separate shell invocations, detached:false did not). Fixed to detached:true unconditionally.
